lines.en: This is my favorite painting in the museum. Do you like it?
lines.pt: Esta é a minha pintura favorita do museu. Gostou?

lines.en: Who painted it? I don't see a name on the wall.
lines.pt: Quem pintou? Não vejo nome na parede.

lines.en: An artist from Spain painted it. Her name is Clara Vidal. She painted it in 1905.
lines.pt: Uma artista da Espanha pintou. O nome dela é Clara Vidal. Ela pintou em 1905.

lines.en: When did she paint it, in winter or summer?
lines.pt: Quando ela pintou, no inverno ou no verão?

lines.en: In the summer, I think. She painted outside with her friends.
lines.pt: No verão, acho. Ela pintava ao ar livre com as amigas.

lines.en: Lovely. Where did she learn to paint? Was there an art school in her city?
lines.pt: Lindo. Onde ela aprendeu a pintar? Havia escola de arte na cidade dela?

lines.en: Her father taught her. She started at age seven.
lines.pt: O pai dela ensinou. Ela começou aos sete anos.

lines.en: What a nice story! Did she sell many pictures? A woman artist had problems.
lines.pt: Que história bonita! Ela vendeu muitos quadros? Uma mulher artista tinha problemas.

lines.en: Not many. After she died, collectors found her work in a trunk.
lines.pt: Não muitos. Depois que ela morreu, colecionadores acharam a obra num baú.

lines.en: Is this the only painting of hers in the museum?
lines.pt: Este é o único quadro dela no museu?

lines.en: No, there are two more. Come with me. I'll show you the best one.
lines.pt: Não, tem mais dois. Venha comigo. Mostro o melhor.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para falar da artista: She painted it in 1905. Pergunte Who painted it? e When did she paint it?

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para falar do que a artista fez, use o passado: She painted it in 1905. She lived in this city. She learned at a small school. Verbos irregulares: teach vira taught, give vira gave.

facts.label: Quem
facts.sub: Quando a pergunta é sobre quem fez, use Who + passado: Who painted it? Não use did aqui. Para outras perguntas, use did: When did she paint it? Where did she learn?

pages.title: A big museum · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a big museum in Manchester. Soft light falls on the old walls. Paulo stops in front of a blue painting. Mona stands near the door. She works here as a guide. She walks over and says hello.
“Hi, Paulo! Do you like this painting?” says Mona. “Yes! Who painted it?” says Paulo. “An artist painted it. Her name was Anna Lee.” says Mona.
